The '''Western Shield''' was a rural countryside region on [[Alanciar]], a continent on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] planet of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. It was connected to the cities of [[Sus'mintri]], [[Uhrar]], and [[Minrath]] by a series of roads. In [[2975 BBY]], the [[High Lord]] [[Edell Vrai]] and his [[Alanciari]] guide [[Quarra Thayn]] traveled through the Western Shield while heading towards Sus'mintri and Uhrar. During the [[invasion of Alanciar]], High Lord [[Korsin Bentado]]'s [[Ebon Fleet]] was shot down by the [[Alanciari military]] over the Western Shield.
